verdict.rationale: Auth0 Private Cloud deployment docs mention meeting 'data-residency' requirements via dedicated deployment on AWS or Azure, implying some regional choice, but this is only for the enterprise-tier Private Cloud offering, not the standard multi-tenant product. missing for 10: explicit list of supported regions/data centers, region-selection mechanism in the standard product/dashboard, and any documentation on residency guarantees for the mainstream SaaS tier.
